tool.name: AddTrailField
tool.summary: Add a trail boolean field to segment features indicating whether a segment is part of a trail. Parses relevant attributes from Overture segment data to determine trail classification.

usage.bullet_item: The input features should be Overture segment features containing the fields necessary for trail identification.
The tool adds or updates a trail field on the input feature class in place.

param.name: input_features
param.dialogReference: The segment feature layer or feature class to which the trail field will be added.
